title.target: Past modals: should have, could have, must have
title.ko: 과거에 대한 추측과 후회: should have · could have
title.en: Past modals: should have, could have, must have

ex.t: She must have been very tired.
He might have forgotten his keys.
I'm certain he was at home.
There must have been a reason she didn't come.
ex.ko: 그녀가 오지 않은 이유가 있었을 거예요.

title.ko: should have · could have · might have · must have · can't have + p.p.
title.en: should have · could have · might have · must have · can't have + past participle

explain.ko: 과거의 일에 대한 후회, 비난, 추측은 조동사 + have + 과거분사로 말합니다. should have는 '~했어야 했는데(안 했다)', could have는 '~할 수도 있었는데(안 했다)'라는 후회·비난을 나타냅니다. might have, must have, can't have는 과거의 일에 대한 추측으로, must have는 거의 확실한 긍정(~했음이 틀림없다), can't have는 거의 확실한 부정(~했을 리 없다), might have는 약한 가능성(~했을지도 모른다)입니다. 부정 후회는 shouldn't have + 과거분사입니다.
explain.en: Modal + have + past participle talks about the past: regret, criticism or guessing. Should have means you didn't do the right thing; could have means you had the chance but didn't. Might have, must have and can't have are guesses: must have = almost certain it happened, can't have = almost certain it didn't, might have = it's possible. Regret about something you did: shouldn't have + past participle.

head: 구조 / Structure
형태 / Form
예문 / Example
rows: She must have been tired. He can't have lied.

notes.ko: should have는 후회(했어야 했다), must have는 확신(했음이 틀림없다)입니다. 뜻을 구분하세요.
notes.en: Should have = regret; must have = strong guess. Do not confuse them.

notes.ko: have는 약하게 /əv/로 발음합니다. 쓸 때는 should of가 아니라 should have입니다.
notes.en: In writing it is should have, never should of.

notes.ko: 확신의 부정은 mustn't have가 아니라 can't have입니다.
notes.en: The certain negative guess is can't have, not mustn't have.

examples.t: She must have been very tired.

practice.q: I ___ left earlier. Now I'm late.
She ___ been very tired. She slept for ten hours.
He ___ lied. He is an honest man.

lines.t: Why didn't you come to the meeting yesterday?

options: I'm sorry. I should have told you.
I'm sorry. I should tell you yesterday.
I'm sorry. I have told you.
He might have missed the bus.
He might miss the bus yesterday.

lines.t: Min-ho hasn't arrived yet. What's happened?
He might have got lost. It's his first time here.
I could have phoned him but I don't have his number.
We should have asked for it. Let's wait.

trans.ko:
A: 민호가 아직 안 왔네. 무슨 일일까?
B: 길을 잃었을지도 몰라. 이 근처는 처음이거든.
A: 전화해 볼 수도 있었는데 번호가 없어.
B: 번호를 받아 놓았어야 했는데. 기다려 보자.

questions.q: Why do they think Min-ho hasn't come?

lines.t: Yesterday I was late for an important exam. I should have set an alarm, but I forgot. I could also have got up earlier, but I watched a film late into the night. I won't make the same mistake next time.

trans.ko: 어제 저는 중요한 시험에 늦었어요. 알람을 맞췄어야 했는데 잊어버렸어요. 또 일찍 일어날 수도 있었지만 밤늦게까지 영화를 봤어요. 다음에는 같은 실수를 하지 않을 거예요.

lines.t: I lost my bag on the train yesterday.
Carriage five. I must have left it on the shelf above the seat.

trans.ko:
직원: 분실물 센터입니다.
손님: 어제 기차에서 가방을 잃어버렸어요.
직원: 어느 칸에 앉으셨어요?
손님: 5번 칸이요. 좌석 위 선반에 두었을 거예요.

items.passage:
1) I ___ left earlier.
2) He ___ got lost.
3) She ___ been very tired.

trans.ko: 1) 나는 더 일찍 출발했어야 했어요. 2) 그는 길을 잃었을지도 몰라요. 3) 그녀는 아주 피곤했음이 틀림없어요.

items.passage: Yesterday I was late for an important exam. I (1) set an alarm, but I forgot. I (2) also have got up earlier, but I watched a film late into the night. The teacher was understanding, but I (3) embarrassed.

trans.ko: 어제 저는 중요한 시험에 늦었어요. 알람을 맞췄어야 했는데 잊어버렸어요. 또 일찍 일어날 수도 있었지만 밤늦게까지 영화를 봤어요. 선생님은 이해해 주셨지만 저는 부끄러웠어요.

items.passage:
NOTE
To Susan: I called last night but you didn't answer. You must have gone to bed early. Or your phone might have been switched off. I'll call again tomorrow morning.

trans.ko:
메모
수잔에게. 어젯밤에 전화했는데 받지 않았어. 일찍 잤음이 틀림없어. 아니면 휴대폰이 꺼져 있었을지도 몰라. 내일 아침에 다시 전화할게.

questions.q: Why does the writer think Susan went to bed early?
When will the writer phone again?

items.passage: Dave lost his wallet yesterday. He thought he might have left it on the bus. The next day the bus company phoned to say they had found it.

trans.ko: 데이브는 어제 지갑을 잃어버렸어요. 그는 버스에 두고 내렸을지도 모른다고 생각했어요. 다음 날 버스 회사에서 전화가 와서 지갑을 찾았다고 했어요.

questions.q: The bus company found the wallet.

expressions.t: I'm sorry. It was my fault.

prompt.ko: 최근에 한 후회되는 일을 should have와 could have를 사용해 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about something you regret, using should have and could have.

task.model: I didn't do my homework yesterday. I should have started earlier. I could have asked a friend for help. I shouldn't have watched TV for so long. My teacher must have been disappointed, and I might have failed.

model_trans.ko: 나는 어제 숙제를 하지 않았어요. 일찍 시작했어야 했어요. 친구에게 도움을 요청할 수도 있었어요. 그러지 말았어야 했는데 TV를 너무 오래 봤어요. 선생님은 실망하셨음이 틀림없고 나는 낙제했을지도 몰라요.
model_trans.en: I didn't do my homework yesterday. I should have started earlier. I could have asked a friend for help. I shouldn't have watched TV for so long. My teacher must have been disappointed, and I might have failed.
